papers.title: NextLongIso: a comprehensive Nextflow pipeline for multi-dimensional long-read RNA-seq analysis
papers.summary: Abstract Summary Long-read RNA sequencing technologies, including Pacific Biosciences (PacBio) and Oxford Nanopore Technologies (ONT), enable direct characterization of full-length transcripts and transcriptome complexity. However, analysis of long-read RNA-seq data remains fragmented across multiple tools, limiting the ability to obtain a unified view of transcript structure, expression, and regulatory variation in long-read transcriptomes. We present NextLongIso, a scalable and reproducible Nextflow pipeline that enables coordinated analysis of multiple layers of transcript regulation. Rather than focusing solely on transcript reconstruction, NextLongIso integrates transcript discovery with downstream regulatory analyses to jointly characterize alternative splicing, isoform switching, transcript boundary dynamics (including alternative promoters and polyadenylation), and transposable element-associated transcription from both PacBio and ONT datasets. By eliminating complex cross-tool data harmonization, this unified framework facilitates the transition from transcript identification to functional interpretation of transcriptomic variation. Availability and Implementation NextLongIso is implemented in Nextflow and is freely available at github: https://github.com/YidanSunResearchLab/nf-LongIso.git and Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21049837
papers.abstract:
SUMMARY: Long-read RNA sequencing technologies, including Pacific Biosciences (PacBio) and Oxford Nanopore Technologies (ONT), enable direct characterization of full-length transcripts and transcriptome complexity. However, analysis of long-read RNA-seq data remains fragmented across multiple tools, limiting the ability to obtain a unified view of transcript structure, expression, and regulatory variation in long-read transcriptomes. We present NextLongIso, a scalable and reproducible Nextflow pipeline that enables coordinated analysis of multiple layers of transcript regulation. Rather than focusing solely on transcript reconstruction, NextLongIso integrates transcript discovery with downstream regulatory analyses to jointly characterize alternative splicing, isoform switching, transcript boundary dynamics (including alternative promoters and polyadenylation), and transposable element-associated transcription from both PacBio and ONT datasets. By eliminating complex cross-tool data harmonization, this unified framework facilitates the transition from transcript identification to functional interpretation of transcriptomic variation.

AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: NextLongIso is implemented in Nextflow and is freely available at github: https://github.com/YidanSunResearchLab/nf-LongIso.git and Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21049837.

SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

papers.llm_title_zh: NextLongIso：一种用于多维长读长RNA测序分析的综合性Nextflow流程工具
papers.llm_title_bilingual: NextLongIso：一种用于多维长读长RNA测序分析的综合性Nextflow流程工具 / NextLongIso: a comprehensive Nextflow pipeline for multi-dimensional long-read RNA-seq analysis
papers.llm_research_question_zh: 摘要：长读长RNA测序技术，如Pacific Biosciences公司的PacBio技术和Oxford Nanopore Technologies公司的ONT技术，能够直接分析全长转录本及其转录组结构特征。
llm_highlights_zh: 然而，对于长读长RNA测序数据的分析目前仍依赖于多种不同的工具，这些工具之间的方法差异导致人们无法获得关于长读长转录组中转录本结构、表达水平及其调控机制的统一认识。
我们提出了NextLongIso这一可扩展且可复现的Nextflow分析流程，该流程能够实现对多层面转录调控机制的协同分析。
NextLongIso并非仅仅专注于转录本的重建，而是将转录本鉴定与下游的调控分析相结合，从而能够全面解析来自PacBio和ONT数据集的可变剪接现象、异构体转换过程、转录本边界的动态变化（包括替代启动子及多聚腺苷酸化作用），以及与转座元件相关的转录活动。
papers.llm_rss_summary_zh:
摘要：长读长RNA测序技术，如Pacific Biosciences的PacBio技术和Oxford Nanopore Technologies的ONT技术，能够直接分析全长转录本及其转录组结构。然而，目前针对这类数据的分析仍依赖于多种不同的工具，这限制了人们从整体上理解长读长转录组的结构、表达模式及调控机制。我们开发的NextLongIso是一种可扩展且具有重复性的Nextflow分析流程，它能够协同分析转录组的多个调控层面。该工具并非仅仅专注于转录本的重建，而是将转录本鉴定与后续的调控分析相结合，从而能够同时解析PacBio和ONT数据集中的可变剪接现象、异构体转换过程、转录边界动态变化（包括不同启动子区域及多聚腺苷化修饰），以及与转座元件相关的转录活动。通过消除跨工具的数据整合环节，这一统一分析框架有效促进了从转录本鉴定到对其功能机制解读的全过程。  

可用性与实施方式：NextLongIso是基于Nextflow平台开发的，其源代码可免费在GitHub和Zenodo平台上获取：  
https://github.com/YidanSunResearchLab/nf-LongIso.git  
https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21049837

all_papers.primary_summary_raw:
SUMMARY: Long-read RNA sequencing technologies, including Pacific Biosciences (PacBio) and Oxford Nanopore Technologies (ONT), enable direct characterization of full-length transcripts and transcriptome complexity. However, analysis of long-read RNA-seq data remains fragmented across multiple tools, limiting the ability to obtain a unified view of transcript structure, expression, and regulatory variation in long-read transcriptomes. We present NextLongIso, a scalable and reproducible Nextflow pipeline that enables coordinated analysis of multiple layers of transcript regulation. Rather than focusing solely on transcript reconstruction, NextLongIso integrates transcript discovery with downstream regulatory analyses to jointly characterize alternative splicing, isoform switching, transcript boundary dynamics (including alternative promoters and polyadenylation), and transposable element-associated transcription from both PacBio and ONT datasets. By eliminating complex cross-tool data harmonization, this unified framework facilitates the transition from transcript identification to functional interpretation of transcriptomic variation.

AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: NextLongIso is implemented in Nextflow and is freely available at github: https://github.com/YidanSunResearchLab/nf-LongIso.git and Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21049837.

SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.
